Sub ProcessClanAndKingdomData()
    Dim wsClan As Worksheet
    Dim wsKingdom As Worksheet
    Dim lastRowClan As Long
    Dim lastRowKingdom As Long
    Dim i As Long, j As Long
    Dim kingdomDict As Object
    Dim clanName As String
    Dim kingdomName As String
    Dim splitArr() As String
    
    ' 设置工作表对象
    Set wsClan = ThisWorkbook.Sheets("Clan")
    Set wsKingdom = ThisWorkbook.Sheets("Kingdom")
    
    ' 获取数据最后一行
    lastRowClan = wsClan.Cells(wsClan.Rows.Count, "A").End(xlUp).Row
    lastRowKingdom = wsKingdom.Cells(wsKingdom.Rows.Count, "A").End(xlUp).Row
    
    ' 创建字典对象用于快速查找王国文化
    Set kingdomDict = CreateObject("Scripting.Dictionary")
    kingdomDict.CompareMode = vbTextCompare  ' 不区分大小写
    
    ' 构建王国-文化字典
    For i = 2 To lastRowKingdom
        kingdomName = Trim(wsKingdom.Cells(i, 1).value)
        If kingdomName <> "" Then
            ' 将王国名称作为键，文化作为值
            kingdomDict(kingdomName) = wsKingdom.Cells(i, 4).value
        End If
    Next i
    
    ' 处理Clan表数据
    For i = 2 To lastRowClan
        ' 任务1: 根据D列的王国名称匹配并获取文化
        kingdomName = Trim(wsClan.Cells(i, 4).value)
        If kingdomName <> "" Then
            If kingdomDict.Exists(kingdomName) Then
                wsClan.Cells(i, 7).value = kingdomDict(kingdomName)  ' G列为第7列
            Else
                wsClan.Cells(i, 7).value = "未找到匹配的王国"
            End If
        End If
        
        ' 任务2: 提取A列中的家族名
        clanName = Trim(wsClan.Cells(i, 1).value)
        If clanName <> "" Then
            ' 按"_"分割字符串
            splitArr = Split(clanName, "_")
            If UBound(splitArr) >= 1 Then
                ' 格式为clan_家族名_数字，取第二部分（索引1）
                ' 使用StrConv函数将家族姓氏的每个单词首字母大写，其他字母小写
                wsClan.Cells(i, 6).value = StrConv(splitArr(1), vbProperCase)  ' 修改这一行，首字母大写
            Else
                wsClan.Cells(i, 6).value = "格式错误"
            End If
        End If
    Next i
    
    ' 清理对象
    Set kingdomDict = Nothing
    Set wsClan = Nothing
    Set wsKingdom = Nothing
    
    MsgBox "处理完成！共处理了 " & lastRowClan - 1 & " 行数据。"
End Sub

已完成。Sub AutoCreateClans()
    Dim wsBase As Worksheet, wsClan As Worksheet
    Dim lastRowBase As Long, lastRowClan As Long, i As Long
    Dim dict As Object, groupDict As Object, nameDict As Object
    Dim surname As String, familyName As String, familyID As String, baseName As String
    Dim mostCommonName As String, maxCount As Long
    Dim tempFamilyName As String, suffix As Integer
    Dim key As Variant, subKey As Variant
    Dim originalName As String, restOfName As String
    Dim resultDict As Object, existingIDs As Object
    Dim matchType As String, autoInfer As String
    Dim bValue As Variant
    Dim familyNameDisplay As String
    
    ' 设置工作表对象
    Set wsBase = ThisWorkbook.Worksheets("BaseInfo")
    Set wsClan = ThisWorkbook.Worksheets("Clan")
    
    ' 获取最后一行
    lastRowBase = wsBase.Cells(wsBase.Rows.count, "B").End(xlUp).Row
    lastRowClan = wsClan.Cells(wsClan.Rows.count, "A").End(xlUp).Row
    
    ' 创建字典
    Set dict = CreateObject("Scripting.Dictionary")
    Set resultDict = CreateObject("Scripting.Dictionary")
    Set existingIDs = CreateObject("Scripting.Dictionary")
    
    ' 收集Clan表中所有已存在的家族ID（使用小写）
    For i = 2 To lastRowClan
        If Not IsEmpty(wsClan.Cells(i, "A")) Then
            existingIDs.Add LCase(CStr(wsClan.Cells(i, "A").value)), 1
        End If
    Next i
    
    ' 第一步：收集符合条件的行并按姓氏分组
    For i = 2 To lastRowBase
        matchType = CStr(wsBase.Cells(i, "E").value)
        autoInfer = CStr(wsBase.Cells(i, "J").value)
        bValue = wsBase.Cells(i, "B").value
        
        ' 检查条件：E列不为"精确匹配"，J列不为"家族和文化自动推断"，B列小于1000
        If matchType <> "精确匹配" And _
           autoInfer <> "家族和文化自动推断" And _
           IsNumeric(bValue) And bValue < 1000 Then
           
            surname = Trim(CStr(wsBase.Cells(i, "D").value))
            If surname <> "" Then
                If Not dict.Exists(surname) Then
                    Set groupDict = CreateObject("Scripting.Dictionary")
                    dict.Add surname, groupDict
                Else
                    Set groupDict = dict(surname)
                End If
                
                baseName = Trim(CStr(wsBase.Cells(i, "G").value))
                If InStr(1, baseName, " ") > 0 Then
                    baseName = Split(baseName, " ")(0)
                End If
                
                groupDict.Add CStr(i), baseName
            End If
        End If
    Next i
    
    Application.ScreenUpdating = False
    
    ' 第二步：处理每个组
    For Each key In dict.Keys
        surname = CStr(key)
        Set groupDict = dict(surname)
        
        ' 找出最常出现的名字
        Set nameDict = CreateObject("Scripting.Dictionary")
        maxCount = 0
        mostCommonName = ""
        
        For Each subKey In groupDict.Keys
            baseName = CStr(groupDict(subKey))
            If Not nameDict.Exists(baseName) Then
                nameDict.Add baseName, 1
            Else
                nameDict(baseName) = nameDict(baseName) + 1
            End If
            
            If nameDict(baseName) > maxCount Then
                maxCount = nameDict(baseName)
                mostCommonName = baseName
            End If
        Next
        
        If mostCommonName <> "" Then
            ' 生成唯一的家族ID
            familyName = mostCommonName
            suffix = 1
            Dim uniqueIDFound As Boolean
            
            ' 尝试生成唯一ID
            Do
                ' 生成家族ID（小写）
                familyID = LCase("clan_" & familyName & "_1")
                
                ' 检查是否已存在
                If Not existingIDs.Exists(familyID) Then
                    ' 在同一批次中也检查
                    uniqueIDFound = True
                    For Each k In resultDict.Keys
                        If resultDict(k)(1) = familyID Then
                            uniqueIDFound = False
                            Exit For
                        End If
                    Next k
                    
                    If uniqueIDFound Then
                        Exit Do
                    End If
                End If
                
                ' 如果已存在，修改家族名
                familyName = mostCommonName & String(suffix, Right(mostCommonName, 1))
                suffix = suffix + 1
            Loop
            
            ' 生成用于显示的家族名（首字母大写）
            familyNameDisplay = UCase(Left(familyName, 1)) & Mid(familyName, 2)
            
            ' 存储结果
            resultDict.Add surname, Array(familyName, familyID, familyNameDisplay)
            
            ' 添加到现有ID列表
            existingIDs.Add familyID, 1
        End If
        
        Set nameDict = Nothing
    Next key
    
    ' 第三步：更新数据
    For Each key In resultDict.Keys
        surname = CStr(key)
        familyName = resultDict(key)(0)  ' 原始家族名（小写）
        familyID = resultDict(key)(1)     ' 家族ID（小写）
        familyNameDisplay = resultDict(key)(2)  ' 显示用的家族名（首字母大写）
        
        ' 更新BaseInfo表
        Set groupDict = dict(surname)
        For Each subKey In groupDict.Keys
            i = CLng(subKey)
            
            ' 更新H列：家族ID（小写）
            wsBase.Cells(i, "H").value = familyID
            
            ' 更新J列：标记
            wsBase.Cells(i, "J").value = "基于分组自动创建家族"
            
            ' 更新G列：替换空格前的部分为显示用的家族名（首字母大写）
            originalName = CStr(wsBase.Cells(i, "G").value)
            If InStr(1, originalName, " ") > 0 Then
                restOfName = Mid(originalName, InStr(1, originalName, " "))
                wsBase.Cells(i, "G").value = familyNameDisplay & restOfName
            Else
                wsBase.Cells(i, "G").value = familyNameDisplay
            End If
        Next
        
        ' 在Clan表中添加新行
        lastRowClan = wsClan.Cells(wsClan.Rows.count, "A").End(xlUp).Row
        With wsClan
            .Cells(lastRowClan + 1, "A").value = familyID                   ' 第1列：家族ID（小写）
            .Cells(lastRowClan + 1, "B").value = surname                    ' 第2列：姓氏
            .Cells(lastRowClan + 1, "C").value = "{=my_" & LCase(familyName) & "}" & familyNameDisplay & "-shi"  ' 第3列：本地化名
            .Cells(lastRowClan + 1, "D").value = ""                         ' 第4列：王国名（留空）
            .Cells(lastRowClan + 1, "E").value = 0                          ' 第5列：0
            .Cells(lastRowClan + 1, "F").value = familyNameDisplay          ' 第6列：家族名（首字母大写）
            .Cells(lastRowClan + 1, "G").value = ""                         ' 第7列：留空
        End With
    Next
    
    Application.ScreenUpdating = True
    
    MsgBox "成功创建 " & resultDict.count & " 个家族！" & vbCrLf & _
           "家族ID全部使用小写，家族名首字母大写。", vbInformation
    
    ' 清理
    Set dict = Nothing
    Set groupDict = Nothing
    Set nameDict = Nothing
    Set resultDict = Nothing
    Set existingIDs = Nothing
End Sub

' 验证函数：检查是否有重复的家族ID
Sub CheckDuplicateClanIDs()
    Dim wsClan As Worksheet
    Dim lastRow As Long, i As Long, j As Long
    Dim idDict As Object, duplicates As Object
    Dim clanID As String, lowerID As String
    Dim duplicateCount As Long
    
    Set wsClan = ThisWorkbook.Worksheets("Clan")
    lastRow = wsClan.Cells(wsClan.Rows.count, "A").End(xlUp).Row
    
    Set idDict = CreateObject("Scripting.Dictionary")
    Set duplicates = CreateObject("Scripting.Dictionary")
    
    ' 收集所有家族ID
    For i = 2 To lastRow
        clanID = Trim(CStr(wsClan.Cells(i, "A").value))
        If clanID <> "" Then
            lowerID = LCase(clanID)
            
            If idDict.Exists(lowerID) Then
                ' 找到重复
                If Not duplicates.Exists(lowerID) Then
                    duplicates.Add lowerID, idDict(lowerID) & "," & i
                Else
                    duplicates(lowerID) = duplicates(lowerID) & "," & i
                End If
                duplicateCount = duplicateCount + 1
            Else
                idDict.Add lowerID, i
            End If
        End If
    Next i
    
    ' 显示结果
    If duplicates.count = 0 Then
        MsgBox "没有发现重复的家族ID。", vbInformation
    Else
        Dim msg As String
        msg = "发现 " & duplicates.count & " 个重复的家族ID:" & vbCrLf & vbCrLf
        
        For Each key In duplicates.Keys
            Dim rowList As Variant
            rowList = Split(duplicates(key), ",")
            msg = msg & "ID: " & key & " 在第 " & Join(rowList, ", ") & " 行重复" & vbCrLf
        Next
        
        MsgBox msg, vbExclamation
    End If
    
    Set idDict = Nothing
    Set duplicates = Nothing
End Sub

Sub CheckClanNameFormat()

    Dim lastRow As Long, i As Long
    Dim incorrectFormat As String
    Dim count As Long
    
    Set wsClan = ThisWorkbook.Worksheets("Clan")
    lastRow = wsClan.Cells(wsClan.Rows.count, "A").End(xlUp).Row
    count = 0
    incorrectFormat = ""
    
    For i = 2 To lastRow
        Dim clanID As String, familyName As String
        clanID = CStr(wsClan.Cells(i, "A").value)
        familyName = CStr(wsClan.Cells(i, "F").value)
        
        ' 检查家族ID是否小写
        If clanID <> LCase(clanID) Then
            count = count + 1
            incorrectFormat = incorrectFormat & "第" & i & "行: 家族ID不是小写 - " & clanID & vbCrLf
        End If
        
        ' 检查家族名是否首字母大写
        If Len(familyName) > 0 Then
            If Left(familyName, 1) <> UCase(Left(familyName, 1)) Then

                incorrectFormat = incorrectFormat & "第" & i & "行: 家族名首字母不是大写 - " & familyName & vbCrLf

    Else
        MsgBox "发现 " & count & " 个格式问题:" & vbCrLf & vbCrLf & incorrectFormat, vbExclamation
    End If
End Sub

' 清理函数：删除所有自动创建的家族
Sub CleanAutoCreatedClans()
    Dim wsBase As Worksheet, wsClan As Worksheet
    Dim lastRowBase As Long, lastRowClan As Long, i As Long
    Dim response As VbMsgBoxResult
    
    response = MsgBox("这将删除所有'基于分组自动创建家族'的记录。" & vbCrLf & _
                     "BaseInfo表的H、J列将被清空，Clan表中相关的行将被删除。" & vbCrLf & _
                     "确定要继续吗？", vbExclamation + vbYesNo, "警告")
    
    If response = vbNo Then Exit Sub
    
    Set wsBase = ThisWorkbook.Worksheets("BaseInfo")
    Set wsClan = ThisWorkbook.Worksheets("Clan")

            wsBase.Cells(i, "J").value = ""
        End If
    Next i

    lastRowClan = wsClan.Cells(wsClan.Rows.count, "A").End(xlUp).Row
    For i = lastRowClan To 2 Step -1
        Dim clanID As String

                            If Not alreadyExists Then

                    Next col
                    
                    '如果找到了据点集合，开始查询流程
                    If settlements.count > 0 Then
                        
                        '步骤1: 在CityTaikou表第1列查找
                        Dim cultureFound As String
                        cultureFound = FindCultureFromCityTaikou(settlements, wsCityTaikou, False)
                        
                        '步骤2: 如果在CityTaikou表第1列没找到，尝试在第5列（别名）查找

                        End If
                        
                        '步骤3: 如果在CityTaikou表找到了文化名，查询Culture表获取文化ID
                        If cultureFound <> "" Then

'函数：在CityTaikou表中查找据点并返回文化名
Function FindCultureFromCityTaikou(settlements As Collection, wsCityTaikou As Worksheet, ByVal useAliasColumn As Boolean) As String
    Dim lastRowCityTaikou As Long
    lastRowCityTaikou = wsCityTaikou.Cells(wsCityTaikou.Rows.count, "A").End(xlUp).Row
    
    Dim c As Long
    For c = 2 To lastRowCityTaikou '假设第1行是标题行
        
        Dim searchColumn As Long
        If useAliasColumn Then
            searchColumn = 5 '第5列是别名
        Else
            searchColumn = 1 '第1列是据点名
        End If
        
        Dim cityName As String
        cityName = Trim(wsCityTaikou.Cells(c, searchColumn).value)
        
        '如果使用别名列，可能有多个别名用逗号分隔
        If useAliasColumn And cityName <> "" Then
            '分割别名
            Dim aliases() As String
            aliases = Split(cityName, ",")
            
            Dim aliasItem As Variant
            For Each aliasItem In aliases
                Dim trimmedAlias As String
                trimmedAlias = Trim(aliasItem)
                
                '检查据点是否在集合中
                Dim settlementItem As Variant
                For Each settlementItem In settlements
                    If trimmedAlias = settlementItem Then
                        '找到匹配的据点，获取文化名（第3列）
                        FindCultureFromCityTaikou = Trim(wsCityTaikou.Cells(c, 3).value)
                        Exit Function
                    End If
                Next settlementItem
            Next aliasItem
        Else
            '检查据点是否在集合中
            Dim settlementItem2 As Variant
            For Each settlementItem2 In settlements
                If cityName = settlementItem2 Then
                    '找到匹配的据点，获取文化名（第3列）
                    FindCultureFromCityTaikou = Trim(wsCityTaikou.Cells(c, 3).value)
                    Exit Function
                End If
            Next settlementItem2
        End If
    Next c
    
    '没有找到
    FindCultureFromCityTaikou = ""
End Function

'函数：在Settlements字典中查找据点并返回文化ID
Function FindCultureFromSettlements(settlements As Collection, dictSettlements As Object) As Variant
    Dim settlementItem As Variant
    For Each settlementItem In settlements
        If dictSettlements.Exists(settlementItem) Then
            FindCultureFromSettlements = dictSettlements(settlementItem)
            Exit Function
        End If
    Next settlementItem
    
    '没有找到
    FindCultureFromSettlements = Empty
End Function

'辅助函数：将列字母转换为列号
Function ColumnLetterToNumber(ByVal colLetter As String) As Integer
    Dim colNum As Integer
    colNum = 0
    
    Dim i As Integer
    For i = 1 To Len(colLetter)
        colNum = colNum * 26 + (Asc(UCase(Mid(colLetter, i, 1))) - Asc("A") + 1)
    Next i
    
    ColumnLetterToNumber = colNum
End Function
